title: SystemMetadata
description: System-level metadata associated with a metadata change, including ingestion run identifiers and provenance information.

runId.description: The identifier of the ingestion run that produced this change.

lastObserved.description: The timestamp when this metadata was last observed in epoch milliseconds.

registryName.description: The name of the model registry associated with this change.

registryVersion.description: The version of the model registry.
